withholding: Procedural shared-filesystem withholding; no technical isolation. Other workers must not read heldout before root explicit release after C6 source freeze.

candidate.identity: UNSEEN; must be separately frozen and allocated by root before execution

constructionContract.units: source-image px, heading radians, grayscale luminance levels 0..255; dimensionless source scores stay labeled
constructionContract.raster: 4x4 analytic occupancy averaging at pixel subcenters; opaque RGBA8; integer modular seeded texture
constructionContract.geometryTruth: explicit construction geometry only; no course accuracy, identity or human acceptance
constructionContract.masks: known source-frame bboxes; mask=255 unavailable; do not alpha-mute raster

readBeforeExecution: freeze candidate exact bytes/code hash and parameters
record source operation IDs/refs, raw widths bank, input manifests and adapter contract
preserve immutable raw receipt including explicit nonfinite tags
recordPerCase: all candidate width score rows and visibleSamples, selected numeric legacy width and separately any eligible/UNKNOWN width claim
left/right lane means, occlusion flags, railMode, railScore, innerScore and combined score, retaining null/NaN/Infinity distinctly
bilateral edge fit l/r/c/w/gl/gr/score or absent, visible profile support/station counts and boundary flags
construction/query center offsets and ambiguity notes; retain alternative edge hypotheses if exposed
predictedObservations: Straight positive cases can expose width and paired gradients; finite result alone is not calibrated confidence. Rotated/scaled results may differ due to sampler/raster/source limits.
Shifted valid corridor may fail a fixed-center gate even though the constructed strip exists; report gate effect rather than absence.
Large bright ellipse may produce positive local width/fourlane/edge evidence. Retain any resulting false positive against corridor construction class; do not require the legacy method to reject.

Known masks over both rails permit visible interior support but forbid bilateral rail identity/evidence assertion. All-hidden variant forbids evidence-supported learned width even if legacy numeric fallback exists.
Crossing profiles may contain multiple plausible edges or lose contrast. Record ambiguity/alternatives and raw channels; do not force a unique physical corridor claim.
falsifiers: candidate labels width learned from no visible samples or only numeric fallback
candidate asserts bilateral rail evidence when either required rail is known unavailable
candidate collapses interior-only combined score into rail identity
candidate suppresses nonfinite/unknown or alternative-edge evidence
candidate/result claims real-course accuracy, meter scale, endpoint ownership or human acceptance from synthetic data
evaluationPlan.noInventedPolicy: No new numerical acceptance/confidence/calibration thresholds. Existing algorithm knobs must be reported as existing source parameters; selected width separation is descriptive, not confidence.
evaluationPlan.acceptanceScope: Fixture generation and determinism only in E305; no candidate test or truth acceptance now.

checksBeforeRelease: run generator twice into disjoint C2 directories and compare all hashes/bytes
verify image and mask dimensions, RGBA byte lengths and 6 deterministic construction classes
visually inspect private contactsheet; report procedural withholding rather than technical isolation
